## cache

Manage the HTTP response cache

```text
Usage: fplr cache [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  clear  Remove all cached responses
  info   Show cache location, entry count and total size
  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
```

## completions

Generate shell completion scripts

```text
Usage: fplr completions [OPTIONS] <SHELL>

Arguments:
  <SHELL>  Shell to generate completions for [possible values: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh]
```

## config

Manage configuration

```text
Usage: fplr config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  set   Set a configuration value
  get   Get a configuration value
  list  List all configuration values
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
```
